item.title: WRESTLING: Back-and-Forth Battle Ends with North Schuylkill Holding Off Pine Grove Area
item.description: In a tightly contested non-league dual meet, North Schuylkill Spartans edged Pine Grove Area Cardinals by a 33–27 final, with several bouts decided by bonus points and clutch late-match performances.
